subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merge, or can maintainers accept source/CI proof for this session-routing change?
rationale: The code path looks narrow, but it changes real message/session delivery behavior and the PR itself says live Telegram proof is still pending.

options.title: Require Live Telegram Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while explicitly owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still drops or misroutes messages.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths before landing targeted routing changes.

recommendation.title: Require Live Telegram Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history across heartbeat, task, and subagent delivery boundaries and is the best available owner for a proof-sufficiency choice.
